priorExposure: ChatGPT in this conversation has relevant prior context about the Diorthosis project, its benchmark, prior review discussions, and linguistic reliability concerns. This review is therefore AI evidence, not a blinded independent human assessment. Within this batch, the original source passages were independently assessed before consulting their provisional annotations or candidate variants. Reviewed only the supplied CHATGPT-REVIEW.md, subjects.jsonl and review.html; did not read the lineage-DO-NOT-SEND-TO-REVIEWERS.json file or access model/prompt condition keys, preparer assessments or repositories.
reviewLimitations: Complete coverage applies only to all 68 subject records of batch 01 (10 source passages), not to any parent dataset or experimental runs. Assessment is AI diagnostic judgment, not human validation; model exact build identifier is unavailable. Source passages are short and have no destination-format rules or surrounding context. Stylistic acceptability of an extra greeting or sentence blank line, Markdown italic markers and their rendering, and the degree of pragmatic meaning in emoji substitution are explicitly noted as uncertain/context-dependent in the affected judgments. Ambiguity is retained as null when a new formatting defect cannot be established. Unassessed/inapplicable source-only and clean-text metrics are null, not success. Candidate quality is separate from delivery: rejected locally valid edits were not delivered; unchanged source fallbacks earn no correction or eligible clean-preservation credit. Multiple identical raw/parsed/rejected texts are duplicate evidence, not independent observations. Supplemental per-error repairs describe the specific candidate only and require later case-bound reconciliation; no human approvals, claim of release readiness, or experimental independence.
